Campus Ledger

Screen by screen design

Every screen of the Student Management System for Admin, Teacher and Student, in light and dark themes on desktop, tablet and mobile. Use the switch at the top for the theme and the buttons on each card for the device.

Section 1

Public pages

Shared header and footer on every page, so the site feels like one product.

Home

Landing page: hero with sample record card, how it works, and the three roles with what each can and cannot do.

Log in

Centered card on ruled notebook paper. Email, password with show/hide, one clear primary button.

Sign up

Students or teachers pick their role, then fill name, email and password with a hint under the password field.

404 page

Friendly message with a clear way back to home (and to the dashboard when signed in).

Section 2

Validation and errors

Same inline error style, message wording and colours everywhere.

Login: required fields

Empty submit shows a message under each field.

Login: wrong password

Generic, clear message so accounts cannot be guessed.

Signup: validation

Teacher role selected, every required field flagged at once.

Mobile menu

Hamburger menu on phones with links and the two auth buttons.

Section 3

Admin

Manages the system and its users.

Admin: overview

Four headline numbers and the list of teachers waiting for approval, each with an Approve button.

Admin: users

Search and filter by role or status. Approve, disable or enable, change role, or delete. Pending accounts float to the top.

Admin: students

Every student record, with edit, results and delete (delete is admin only).

Section 4

Teacher

Works with students.

Teacher: overview

Student and result counts plus the most recently added students.

Teacher: students

Add and edit students and open their results. No delete button for teachers.

Section 5

Student

Uses the system for their own information.

Student: overview

Own profile, overall average, best subject and results table. Nothing about other students.

Student: my profile

Read-only record plus a form for the only fields a student may change.

Section 6

Dialogs and feedback

Confirmations, forms in dialogs, and success messages use one consistent pattern.

Success toast

Shown after login, save, approve and delete. Same place and style every time.

Account menu

Name, email, role badge, Dashboard and Sign out.

Change role

Admin picks a new role for a user.

Delete confirmation

Every delete asks first and names what will be lost.

Add student: validation

Errors appear under each field inside the dialog.

Add student: filled form

Two-column form on desktop, one column on phones (dialog becomes a bottom sheet).

Confirm before saving

Saving a student record asks for confirmation.

Student results

Add a result with marks validation, and see or delete existing results.

Screens captured from the running app. Fonts: Fraunces for headings and Hanken Grotesk for text. This gallery uses fallback fonts if they are not installed on your computer.
